source_review: Additive nonvirtual owned DB reports preserve old subclass overrides. Unknown defaults cannot satisfy required scope. Observations retain identities before child deletion; normalized logical keys are separate from per-input rows and policy exclusions.

Stream scanner sets complete only after validated magic/EOF discovery, recovered prefix on sliced header/payload, failed on seek/tell/read/cancel; same wide checked payload span advances and publishes key/boundary only after success. ReadOnly scan does not rewrite files; Append retains old salvage policy.

POSIX DT_UNKNOWN classifies entry with lstat and exact (mode&S_IFMT)==S_IFREG, preserving native regular-only scope across local sockets and links. Windows fallback skips reparse points before stat; only source-reviewed, no native runtime claim.

Production normal/progress/both controllers share actual selection helper; required uncertainty is checked before zero work/export/hints and cannot become successful by narrowing. Optional failures retain named exclusions without item execution; filters remain required.

OS metadata carries actual input/filter/policy scalars and exact key/exclusion sets through a bounded exact-commit record. Bounds use subtraction with aligned header/list checks; private protocol compatibility is explicitly same-commit.

Ranges use sorted filtered keys with old clamping; prehint indices survive suppression. Private producer adapters observe real dispatch and original worker index. No shipping test switch or hook added.

All changed tests use explicit DiagnosticChecks active under NDEBUG, isolated CTest workdirs and watchdogs. Five source-only isolated mutation patches leave tests unchanged and require ordinary1 intended assertion plus healthy0.

Incoming master #19 originating support/dependency/warning behavior remains outside base-to-candidate diff. Both changelog entries and registration/docs sections retained. Shared outcome fixture adds only an optional private observer and a distinct main guard compatible with incoming include guard.
